$comment: Machine-readable spec for the BDC Promotions paid landing page. Source of truth for QA of the /lp route. Values mirror src/components/lp/constants.ts and src/app/lp/layout.tsx; do not edit one without the other.
name: BDC Promotions — Free Dealership Marketing Audit landing page

form.name: lp-lead-form
form.submitControl: Validate-first type="button" whose onClick runs client validation then calls formRef.requestSubmit(); the native <form onSubmit> then performs the submit. Intentionally NOT a native type="submit" — prevents empty/invalid submissions from firing optimizer conversion events.
form.behavior: Fail-closed: only a server-confirmed { ok: true } response fires conversion events and shows success. A failed/unconfirmed submit shows a retryable error, fires no analytics, and keeps fields editable. A synchronous inFlightRef guard prevents duplicate submits.

fields.name: email
fields.label: Work email
fields.validation: RFC-5322-lite pattern; blocks submit until valid

fields.name: phone
fields.label: Phone
fields.validation: Strips non-numeric, limits to exactly 10 digits, auto-formats as (XXX) XXX-XXXX; blocks submit until 10 digits

fields.name: inventorySize
fields.label: How many vehicles do you currently have in your inventory?

qualifier.question: How many vehicles do you currently have in your inventory?
qualifier.behavior: The answer is captured as form metadata (qualified = inventorySize === "50 or more") and rides along with the lead. Qualification NEVER suppresses delivery: both answers are submitted and routed. The qualifier tailors follow-up; it does not gate access to the free audit.

tracking.note: LP tracking is isolated to /lp via src/app/lp/layout.tsx; the primary site's analytics are suppressed on /lp (PrimaryRouteOnly). GTM and Meta Pixel are installed by the optimizer via MEGA_TAG_CONFIG — never added as separate manual scripts.

hero.headline: Turn paid social into more qualified showroom appointments

content.offer: Free dealership marketing audit and consultation — no cost, no obligation.
